  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MAY 13, 2025

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 8:30 p.m., on
  Tuesday, May 13, 2025, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Housing Authority Member Hajar Muqtasid St. Claire
  Housing Authority Member Belinda Phillips

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Elaine Polachek
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council and Housing Authority Board
  convened to a special joint meeting at 8:30 p.m., with all members present.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on Closed Session items.
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY:

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council and Housing Authority Board
  recessed at 8:31 p.m., to consider Closed Sessions and returned at 10:50 p.m.,
  (Housing Authority Members  with all members present, except Housing Authority Members Phillips and
  Phillips and Muqtasid St.  Muqtasid St. Claire, to report the following:
  Claire left the meeting at 8:55
  P.M.)  5.A. Conference with legal counsel - potential initiation of litigation
  regarding HUD Continuum of Care and Department of Transportation
  grants - Gov. Code § 54956.9(d)(4), King County, et al. v. Scott Turner,
  et al., USDC # 2:25-cv-00814-BJR (W.D. Wash.)

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard and that the Housing
  Authority and Council gave direction to participate in the referenced
  litigation.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council adjourned at
  10:50 p.m.

  1  May 13, 2025
